sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** Self-employment loan scheme for Rabari and Bharwad women in Gujarat, offering up to ₹2 lakh at 5% annual interest to promote economic independence.
**Who is this for:** Individual, Business Entity; Category: Business & Entrepreneurship; Sector: Setting up / start-up / entrepreneurship

**Detailed Description:** The **New Swarnima Scheme** is a financial empowerment initiative by the **Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam** under the **Social Justice and Empowerment Department**. It aims to provide **100% loan** support to women from the **Rabari and Bharwad communities** to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship. Eligible women between the **age of 21 and 45 years**, with an **annual family income up to ₹3 lakh**, can receive a **loan of up to ₹2 lakh** at a subsidized **interest rate of 5% per annum** to start a business of their choice. The scheme is designed to increase economic independence and livelihood generation among backward class women.

Benefits / Assistance: - 100% loan assistance provided to eligible women- Loan amount up to ₹2.00 lakh- Interest rate fixed at 5% per annum- Loan can be used to start a business of the beneficiary’s choice- Meant for economically backward women of specific castes- Encourages entrepreneurship and self-reliance

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official [**DAADC**](https://daadconline.gujarat.gov.in/) online portal. **Step 2:** **Register/log in** using your credentials. **Step 3:** Fill out the application form with accurate personal and scheme-specific details. **Step 4:** Upload the **required documents** and submit.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department
**Tags:** Rabari Bharwad Scheme, Gopalak Vikas Nigam, Women Entrepreneurs, Gujarat Loan Scheme
